Players Committee card image of [[The Mythrol / •The Mythrol (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “The Mythrol's game text may not be canceled. If about to leave table, place out of play. Plays only during start of game by revealing from outside your deck to replace a just-deployed Jabba's Prize imprisoned in Security Tower. If not revealed, place this card under your Starting Effect. [Set 1] Despair targets The Mythrol instead of Jabba's Prize. Cancels Stunning Leader here. If just released, either flip this card or place it out of play.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/themythrolfront.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/0ab9fb866cb766f1913af967a4ab9b30668559cd 0ab9fb8] (1 July 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
